note: Each client request replayed against the real v0.20.0 app (the satellite-0.20.2 rows against the 0.20.2 app), for every password state, peer shape and credential. Each fixture's results are [status, verdict] pairs in the order of matrix.cells (password|peer|credential). The public peer is a documentation address standing in for an internet one; the old app ran with Python told it is not private, as a real internet address is not.

auth_refusal_details: This device has no password yet, so it only allows this from its own screen. Add a password in Settings to use it from anywhere.
rule.text: auth_refused for a 401, a redirect to /ui/login, or a 403 whose detail is one of auth_refusal_details; passed for anything else
